# Grove Circle Healing

> Sound healing, voice activation, and corporate wellness experiences with Chris Young-Ginzburg, a sound healer based in Sonoma County, California. Private sessions, group events, retreats, corporate wellness programs, online courses, and community gatherings — serving Sonoma County (Santa Rosa, Sebastopol, Petaluma), the San Francisco Bay Area, and beyond. Online offerings are available worldwide.

Grove Circle Healing is the practice of Chris Young-Ginzburg, a sound healer, voice activator, and intuitive guide. Sessions combine crystal singing bowls, drumming, guided meditation, breath awareness, and vocal toning. The work is trauma-aware and neuroscience-informed, supporting stress relief, nervous system regulation, burnout prevention, and team connection. Past clients include Sephora, All Day I Dream, Deep House Yoga, and Waking Hour.

## How to hire or book

- Private sound healing (one-on-one, 90 min, in-home, Sonoma County area): starting at $700
- Private group home visit (90 min): starting at $800
- Corporate wellness sessions, retreats, weddings, festivals, ceremonies, and private events: custom pricing based on group size, travel, location, and duration — from a 45-minute lunchtime sound bath to a full-day immersive retreat
- Event & corporate inquiry form: https://form.jotform.com/260485852564163
- Discovery calls and general booking: https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/#contact
- Email: fluidgirlproductions@gmail.com

## Common questions

### Where can I find a sound healer in Sonoma County?
Chris Young-Ginzburg of Grove Circle Healing offers private sound healing sessions throughout Sonoma County, including Santa Rosa, Sebastopol, Petaluma, and surrounding areas, as well as select private and group experiences beyond the county. Sessions take place in person at the client's home.

### What is sound healing?
Sound healing is a guided experience that uses gentle sounds, breath, and relaxation to help the body slow down and reset. In a Grove Circle Healing session, Chris uses crystal singing bowls, gongs and chimes, a medicine drum, rain drum, maracas, and her voice. Participants simply lie back, listen, and receive. People often report deep physical relaxation, emotional release, clarity, and renewed energy.

### How much does a private sound healing session cost?
A one-on-one, 90-minute in-home session starts at $700. A 90-minute private group home visit starts at $800. Both include a full sound healing experience, breath awareness and vocal toning, and integration and grounding time.

### Can I hire a sound healer for a corporate team, retreat, or event?
Yes. Grove Circle Healing offers corporate wellness sessions, retreats, weddings and birthday parties, music festivals, ceremonies, baby and mother blessings, spiritual events, and yoga events, from a 45-minute lunchtime sound bath to a full-day immersive retreat. Experiences combine guided meditation, live crystal bowls, and optional voice activation. Pricing is custom, based on group size, travel, location, and duration. Past clients include Sephora, Deep House Yoga, and Waking Hour. Inquiry form: https://form.jotform.com/260485852564163

### What is voice activation?
Voice activation is a workshop practice that reconnects people with their natural voice through breath, movement, and joyful self-expression. A free introduction is available at https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/voice-activation-basics

### Are there online options?
Yes. Self-paced online courses and a monthly membership are available worldwide: https://www.grovecirclehealing.com/online-courses
